ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future program and the allegations of fraud. It would explore the extent of the fraud, the individuals and organizations involved, and the impact on the community.
questions: Who was involved in the fraud?
What was the impact on the community?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future program was a prime target for fraudulent activity due to its large budget and lack of oversight. Investigating this program can reveal a complex web of corruption and potentially lead to significant recoveries.

ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would explore the allegations of fraud in the Minnesota Medicaid program. It would examine the types of fraud, the individuals and organizations involved, and the efforts to combat it.
questions: What types of fraud are being committed?
Who is involved in the fraud?
What is being done to prevent it?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota Medicaid program is vulnerable to fraud due to its complex nature and large budget. Investigating this program can reveal areas for improvement and potentially lead to significant recoveries.
